msgs: BELLUNO. Down out of the mountains to the Piazza dei Martiri. The Dolomites end to end, rifugio to rifugio.
Pederü. Strudel and coffee at the guesthouse at the road end. The rifugio says the Forcella del Lago still has snow on the north side.
Done. A spritz in the piazza and the train home from Belluno.
Day 1. Lago di Braies solo, green water and a crowd of day-trippers. Up the scree to the Rifugio Biella. Belluno is 120 km south.
Afternoon storms again tomorrow. Up early, over the high stuff by noon: that's the rule up here.
Thunderstorms forecast for tomorrow afternoon and a pass above treeline. Alarm set for an alpine start.
Hail and lightning on the exposed part. Nowhere to hide up there, so I just kept moving, fast, down to the first trees.
Caught above treeline when the storm hit. Hair standing up, poles buzzing. Ran for the trees and didn't stop until I was well below the ridge.
Thunder right overhead on the high stretch, the gap between flash and boom down to a second. Crouched on my pad between strikes, then moved fast.
Cortina d'Ampezzo! Ate two dinners.
Finished my section after 73 miles. Back to real life.
